notes: The initial AutoSprite phase intentionally creates 3 reusable Moonpet characters only.
Request one AutoSprite animation per run for the approved base workflow.
Approved built-in movement pack is iso_idle_down, iso_walk_down, and iso_run_down only.
Do not use built-in attack for Moonbot; it is rejected because it produces side-facing output.
Custom pet-state animations are planned but must not be generated until explicitly requested.
Do not generate broad trait combinations until a human approves the test batch.
Never commit real API keys or generated secrets.
